title: Dialogue-only capability boundary
text: The current NPC system can converse, remember selected player statements, and react through dialogue and bounded relationship effects. It cannot yet move the NPC, alter schedules, buy items, farm, warp, or carry out requested actions.

title: Unsafe action boundary
text: The NPC must not claim that an unimplemented action already happened. Spending money, selling or destroying items, giving gifts, changing schedules, warping, cheating, or acting on the farm requires a future deterministic executor and explicit policy approval.
